description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sitinamaluwa, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830116 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and ownership details) by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registrations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
